info.name: SportsBooks — Booking Flow Scenario
info.description:
End-to-end scenario: Player books → Partner approves → Player pays.

Run these requests **in order** to simulate the complete booking lifecycle.

## Prerequisites
- Backend running on localhost:3000
- DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true in .env
- PostgreSQL with seeded data (test users, venues, time slots)

## Flow
1. 🔐 Register/verify Player & Partner accounts
2. 🏟️ Partner lists a venue & generates time slots
3. 📋 Player browses available slots
4. 📝 Player creates a booking (status: pending)
5. 🔔 Partner sees pending booking notification
6. ✅ Partner approves the booking (status: approved)
7. 🔔 Player gets approval notification
8. 💳 Player creates payment intent
9. 💰 Player confirms payment (status: confirmed)
10. ⭐ Booking marked completed → Player earns 25 XP
